# MUCOMSX authored tooling patterns

These short original note patterns check tooling only: ordinary OPNA SSG,
internal MSX PSG, the three-part SCC SSG extension and CH3 operator pages.
FM3 uses the separately installed release's synthetic FMVOICE.DAT. No factory
bank, third-party binary, song or DOS/ROM file is redistributed here.

They are not VGM-converter output or a claim of source-to-target fidelity.
See docs/mucomsx_setup.md for staging, execution and validation status.
